field: Q polynomial identities, valid over C

partner_identities.coverage: All nonzero complex rank-one v: v3 chart, reversed v0 chart, and two reversed coordinate endpoints.

seven_by_seven_control.scope: Compatible first spaces and an exact polynomial identity with first rank twelve; not a matrix target.

invertible_line_control.scope: Compatible first spaces and an exact polynomial identity with first rank twelve; not a matrix target.

consequence: With both mixed projections nonzero, both are lines: either rank-one partners with quotient ranks <=7 each, or invertible lines with quotient ranks exactly1 each.
